ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an ideal operational amplifier circuit. The output terminal is labeled VOUT, and on the right a load resistor RL = 100 Ω is connected to ground; this load is only connected at the output terminal for measuring the output voltage. Above, there is resistor RIN from the input voltage source VIN connected to the node related to the op-amp inverting input, and resistor RF feeds back from the output terminal to the same upper node. Below, VREF forms a voltage-divider network through resistors R1 and R2 and is connected to the non-inverting input of the op-amp; the op-amp supply is labeled +12 V and -12 V. Reasoning: Since VREF is fixed, and the bias given by the R1, R2 divider to the non-inverting terminal is also fixed, VOUT can be written as a linear form with respect to VIN: a fixed bias term plus a gain term related to VIN. Subtracting two given operating points eliminates the fixed bias term. It is known that VOUT changes from 1 V to 6 V, so ΔVOUT = 6 - 1 = 5 V; VIN changes from -0.1 V to 1 V, so ΔVIN = 1 - (-0.1) = 1.1 V. According to the bridging relationship in the method specified by the problem, R_F/R_IN = 1 + ΔVOUT/ΔVIN = 1 + 5/1.1 = 5.54545..., approximately 5.55.

图像描述：图中是一个理想运算放大器电路。输出端标为 VOUT，右侧接有负载电阻 RL = 100 Ω 到地；该负载只是接在输出端用于测量输出电压。上方有电阻 RIN 从输入电压源 VIN 接到运放反相输入相关节点，电阻 RF 从输出端反馈到同一上方节点。下方 VREF 通过电阻 R1、R2 构成分压网络并接到运放的同相输入端；运放供电标为 +12 V 和 -12 V。
